protocol.method: Prominent speed lobes propose count; intervening speed minima seed times; free timing with endpoint-constrained linear LS at every residual evaluation
protocol.objective: Raw XYZ position squared error only; no opposition penalty
protocol.selection: Count from nominal detector, never adjusted from fitted error; lowest RMSE successful endpoint-valid fit at that count
protocol.initializations: Uniform base/jitter and motion seed base/jitter; at proposed K use detected-valley seed, at other K use speed-minimum slots; seed 23
protocol.fairness: Identical target, endpoints and prescribed K. Four nonlinear timing starts versus one exact linear fixed-time solve; unequal compute. Starts depend on K; no global-optimum claim.
protocol.scope: Two 3 s windows from the same original clip; not full-clip conversion or biological unit identification

18_21.rule: One speed lobe per retained prominent peak, interior boundaries at lowest sample between adjacent peaks; crop endpoints cover edges; no peaks falls back to K=1

30_33.rule: One speed lobe per retained prominent peak, interior boundaries at lowest sample between adjacent peaks; crop endpoints cover edges; no peaks falls back to K=1
